sentences.text: In 1946 Vietnam and France signed two agreements, in March and September, but they still disagreed about who held real power.
In November French forces took control of the port of Hải Phòng and moved toward Lạng Sơn.
In December the tension in Hà Nội grew.
French troops fired in several streets, and on 18 December the French commander sent an ultimatum.
At Vạn Phúc, near Hà Đông, Hồ Chí Minh and the Party leaders met on 18–19 December and decided to call the whole country to resist, and on the 19th he wrote his Appeal for Nationwide Resistance.
Historians still disagree about who bears responsibility for the outbreak of war that evening.
